{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABViBVJQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6Pzg_Dg2o", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 24, "title": "Update mmd-parser dependency to 1.1.2", "body": "## Problem

`three-mmd-loader` currently depends on `mmd-parser ^1.1.1`.

`mmd-parser@1.1.2` has now been released and includes the PMX additional UV morph parsing fix for morph types 4–7. The parser now consumes and exposes those morph element payloads correctly, preserving reader alignment for subsequent PMX data.

`three-mmd-loader` should use the newly released parser version so consumers get that fix through the normal runtime dependency.

## Expected outcome

Update `three-mmd-loader` to require `mmd-parser@1.1.2` or newer within the intended compatible range, and verify the package, loader, browser examples, and isolated consumers continue to work with the released dependency.

## Scope

- Update the runtime dependency from the current range starting at `1.1.1` to a range starting at `1.1.2`.
- Update the lockfile or other dependency metadata if this repository tracks one.
- Update documentation that names the minimum supported `mmd-parser` version.
- Keep parser APIs imported directly from `mmd-parser`; do not reintroduce vendored parser code or compatibility re-exports.
- Do not implement application of additional UV morphs in `three-mmd-loader` in this Issue. This Issue is only about consuming the corrected parser release.
- Do not change unrelated MMD rendering, animation, physics, or export behavior.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] `package.json` requires `mmd-parser` with a semver range whose minimum is `1.1.2` (for example `^1.1.2` if that remains the intended compatibility policy).
- [ ] A clean install resolves a released `mmd-parser` version satisfying the new range and not `1.1.1`.
- [ ] Add or update an automated regression check proving the installed `mmd-parser` can parse a PMX additional UV morph (type 4–7) without losing alignment of following PMX data.
- [ ] The regression uses the installed package dependency rather than repository-local parser source.
- [ ] Existing parser imports in `MMDLoader` / `MMDExporter` remain direct imports from `mmd-parser`.
- [ ] No vendored parser implementation or declaration is reintroduced under `src/`.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run test:browser` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build:examples` passes.
- [ ] `npm run test:examples` passes.
- [ ] `npm pack` followed by the existing isolated consumer checks passes with the installed `mmd-parser` dependency.
- [ ] Documentation reflects `mmd-parser@1.1.2` as the minimum runtime dependency where a version is stated.
- [ ] No manual visual inspection or post-merge-only validation is required.

## Required post-merge verification

None. All required behavior must be verifiable on the PR branch before merge.

## Context

The parser fix was released in `mmd-parser@1.1.2` after the additional UV morph parsing work for PMX morph types 4–7. `three-mmd-loader` already treats `mmd-parser` as an external runtime dependency, so the expected change here is a focused dependency update plus regression coverage.
